scenes.narration: 在这里交代主人公从哪里出发，要前往哪里，以及途中发生了什么。
code: const T = api.t; const C = TT.chronicle; const MAP = C.readData(api.data('map'));
const cue = api.cues[0]; const at = (dt = 0) => cue.start + dt;
TT.board.stage(ctx, { W, H }, { seed: 3, variant: 0, screen: 'white' });
const frame = C.map(ctx, MAP, { t: T, at: 0.25, x: 150, y: 135, w: 1620, h: 665, style: 'antique' });
C.place(ctx, { t: T, at: at(0.2), frame, point: MAP.places.peixian.point, name: '沛县' });
C.place(ctx, { t: T, at: at(0.6), frame, point: MAP.places.lishan.point, name: '骊山' });
const route = C.route(ctx, { t: T, at: at(0.5), duration: 2.4, frame, points: MAP.routes.toFengxi, color: 'red' });
if (route) C.seal(ctx, { t: T, at: at(0.4), x: route.x, y: route.y - 48, text: '刘', radius: 42, active: true });
C.systemCaption(ctx, api.cues.find((c) => T >= c.start && T < c.end), { t: T, W, H });
TT.board.stageFrame(ctx, { W, H });
